notes.title: American Arcadia is Out Now!
notes.content:
[h1]American Arcadia is Out Now![/h1]

[previewyoutube=DTjD0oH-cGw;full][/previewyoutube]

Hey everyone,

Today is the release day and we are super excited to share American Arcadia with all of you!

In Out of the Blue, we always like to develop new experiences, and we're passionate about exploring new stories in every game. That is why people were surprised by how different the game was from our previous title, Call of the Sea.

Two ideas were really captivating us: the “escaping from a dystopia” theme, which is a kind of story that we all love in Out of the Blue Games, and the 70’s setting and aesthetic, which we believed is not that exploited in games and we find really appealing. So we can say that in the end, American Arcadia was born after combining both of these concepts.  But American Arcadia is much more than a “escape from a 70’s dystopia” game.

We wanted to tackle a more contemporary dystopia: the society we currently inhabit. One obsessed with appearance, likes, and instant gratification. A society dominated by exhibitionism, where personal life seems to fade away, and every aspect of our private lives is subject to external scrutiny. The message we would like to share with American Arcadia is that you don't need to share your life to be happy, because in the end, you are not living your life, you are living a display life for others. Just because your life is simple, it doesn’t mean it has to be boring.

American Arcadia is also a story about cooperation and friendship. And this game would not have been possible if it wasn't for the passion, craft, and care that each member of the team has put into the development. This game is huge in every sense, compared to Call of the Sea, and teamwork was the key.

We genuinely hope you immerse yourself in the world we've created and enjoy this tale about privacy and corporate greed to the fullest!

Out of the Blue

notes.title: In the Shadow of Dreams: The Untold Story of the First Arcadia
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42313396/a2c0ec288a4c8d9bf437efb7d719604642632092.png[/img]

We are getting closer to American Arcadia’s season premiere, but this time we want to take a look back and dig into Arcadia’s past and how it became the perfect city for luxury and comfort that it is today.

Arcadia was never meant to be a big megalopolis. In fact, it began as a dream in the mind of a visionary filmmaker turned city planner. Today, we delve into the captivating history of Project Arcadia, a city that was conceived by the legendary Elijah Walton and brought to life by his unwavering determination.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42313396/a4c0a8e680952250aaab00c49611a7b78a7870db.png[/img]

[h1]Elijah Walton: From Small-Town Dreamer to Hollywood Luminary[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42313396/fa639809e4aef23bf1072a68b9c88c658e6dbdee.png[/img]

Elijah Walton's journey began in the quiet corners of Minnesota, where he was born in 1900. From a young age he was captivated by the works of Jules Verne, who fueled his dreams of becoming a novelist or scientist. However, destiny had other plans and lead him to the bustling world of Hollywood's film industry.

In the 1930s, Elijah, alongside his brother Donald, founded Walton Pictures. Together they embarked on a cinematic journey that produced numerous box office hits, many of which have since become timeless classics. Yet, Elijah yearned for something more, a way to reach a broader audience beyond the silver screen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42313396/7eef34267ed8f1c47b14859868cee88b06e859dd.png[/img]

[h1]Architects of Tomorrow TV Show: A 1950s Sensation[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42313396/a259378f013298a5fbcb48f257caedd936aaf4cc.png[/img]

The breakthrough came with the advent of television, as the innovative 3D audio and video system, Visi-O-Rama, brought forth the legendary "Architects of Tomorrow" TV show. A Saturday night staple in the 1950s, the show was renowned for its unique songs, the seamless blend of live action and animation, and the heartfelt goodbye message delivered by Elijah Walton himself as he cruised away in his prototype electric car, aptly named The Waltonmobile.

[h1]Project Arcadia & Walton's Dream Unfolds[/h1]

The pinnacle of Walton's ambitions arrived when Walton Media, formerly Walton Pictures, set its sights on an audacious project—the creation of a city of the future, Arcadia. Alongside his trusted partner and "Architects of Tomorrow" host, Arpad Kovacs, the first prototype of the Arcadia Project began to take shape. Today, this prototype community is known as 'Classic Arcadia' or 'Old Arcadia.'

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42313396/057d96570ef943e7a68e22efeef2d5b09a6a97d2.png[/img]

[h1]The Tragic Loss of Elijah Walton[/h1]

Tragically, the visionary mind behind Project Arcadia would not live to see his magnum opus completed. On June 3rd, 1963, the world lost one of the 20th century's most talented minds to a sudden heart failure.

In the wake of his brother's passing, Donald Walton stepped up to lead the company. Under his stewardship, Project Arcadia was brought to fruition according to its ambitious schedule.

[h1]The Unveiling: American Arcadia's Premiere[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42313396/50e630e795b5ad1eee5a62b2600e4c80a20b1e3d.png[/img]

American Arcadia's premiere was an event that rivaled even the Apollo XI Moon landing in viewership. Yet, what the first residents of Arcadia didn't realize was that their private lives were being broadcasted to the nation.

[h1]Arcadia's Meteoric Rise and the Burbank Act[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42313396/232bbf134abdd06fca431d9a716ad8311f37d4be.png[/img]

The city's success drew a flood of new residents, rapidly outgrowing Old Arcadia. It was clear that a larger, more modern city was needed to fulfill Elijah Walton's grand vision. Through the collaboration between Walton Media and Senator Milton Burbank, the Burbank Act was passed, allowing Arcadia to expand to the size that had always been envisioned.



So, if you've been intrigued by the tale of Project Arcadia and want to dive deeper into its mysteries, we encourage you to stay tuned for the release of American Arcadia!

Be among the first to explore this fascinating narrative and immerse yourself in a world where a perfect life is nothing but a perfect lie. 

Follow us on Twitter at @AmericanArcadia and if you haven’t done it yet, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1249040/American_Arcadia/]wishlist American Arcadia[/url] today on Steam 

Out of the Blue

notes.title: American Arcadia: All We Know So Far
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42313396/214141002737cd648b9623c83e75d7caa7691aa0.png[/img]
Hello there!

We have been working hard on American Arcadia, hence the radio silence here. But we are back 📺 and ready to dig deeper into Arcadia’s little secrets.

Curious about them?  Let’s first do a little recap about All we know about American Arcadia so far, and maybe unveil a couple of new things that will have a wider explanation as we get closer to the release date.

Here are some fun facts about the most watched media phenomenon on the planet!

[h1]IT'S ALWAYS SUNNY IN ARCADIA[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42313396/5756e63b3b6da09048f691cecd244868969cf6ad.jpg[/img]

American Arcadia is set on an immense 43-square-mile retro-futuristic metropolis suspended in time. Inside it, under a weather-controlled dome,  their citizens enjoy an endless spring throughout the whole year.

[h1]A DIFFERENT KIND OF 1970'S[/h1]

Arcadia’s citizens enjoy a life of luxury and comfort, filled with all types of modern conveniences, like cleaning robots, drones, electric cars… all carefully designed to look like 1970’s props!

[h1]ALWAYS LIVE![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42313396/8b93d2ec310d08802d29a85155050aed47fa3a5a.jpg[/img]
Broadcast live 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, on every digital platform, American Arcadia has a complex system of thousands of cameras which registers the everyday lives of their 23.414 Arcadia-born citizens.

[h1]ARCADIA'S #1 CELEBS[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42313396/610bb4b8287090f563bc54cdf8a8e4ac5ae72bcd.png[/img]
And who are the most famous Arcadia citizens? Of course number one still is the aerobic world champion [b]Steve Just[/b], followed by his girlfriend, supermodel [b]Tiffany Amber Gaines[/b]. Among others are music [b]DJ Zoom[/b] or singer [b]Merle Jefferson[/b]. These people get American Arcadia’s ratings go high, and everything that happens to them, from love to drama is commented live and followed by millions of viewers.

[h1]"LIVE FROM THE ARCADIA DOME, I'M YOUR HOST, VIVAN WALTON"[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42313396/5c9dbc2c921d80af37ff80690af9df1765e9a3bb.png[/img]
And what would be of American Arcadia without the true star of the show? Arcadia´s city representative, club owner, and caustic show host… the one and only Vivian Walton! 
There is a lot to share about Miss Walton, but we will leave that for another blog.

[h1]TUNE IN FOR THE 55TH SEASON![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42313396/a9150b1fe987c874ecc97c0ed40fa4853fac43c6.png[/img]
Are you ready for the 55th season?
Login to your AA Live app and vote, comment and be a part of... American Arcadia!

Make sure you follow [url=https://twitter.com/AmericanArcadia]@americanarcadia[/url] so you don’t miss out on the new things we’ll be showing soon!

notes.title: American Arcadia Breaks Into Gamescom
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42313396/088ee9aa4917949369533fb63ff03051487ee8d8.png[/img]

[h3]Hi there Arcadians![/h3]

Some weeks ago we travelled to Cologne to attend Gamescom, where we spent some lovely days presenting American Arcadia to the European press.

Out of the Blue’s co-founder and Creative Director Tatiana Delgado and Lead Writer Alfredo Gonzalez-Barros were there to keep American Arcadia's ratings rising and giving the press a sneak peek of the full game in our first European hands-on demo. To help them remember us better we also provided a little device to help block unwanted observation - you never know who might be watching ;)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42313396/ef66590251a7ce07c38ebf8f200e4d72a914a1bf.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42313396/be2ce29c128808935a5f3f7e99275c6316c24afa.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42313396/2079e3a256f7136c27ea5324d720e65640f323a8.png[/img]

We received amazing feedback from Gamescom and also a lot of questions concerning the plot of the game, the characters, and the mechanics:

[i]“I was just so engrossed in the game's mixture of side-scrolling platforming and first-person puzzling. Keep American Arcadia under surveillance, because I think it's going to be a real hit when it lands.” [/i]
- [url=https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/american-arcadia-is-a-genre-flipping-cinematic-feast-from-the-call-of-the-sea-devs]Rock Paper Shotgun[/url]

[i]“American Arcadia is shaping up to be something really special. The Truman Show-style set up is familiar, but the way that Out of the Blue has realized this kitschy 70s utopia is simply wonderful. The way they then contrast it with the second viewpoint and blend more ideas into the side-scrolling escape makes it really feel like American Arcadia will be more than the sum of its parts.”[/i] 
- [url=https://www.thesixthaxis.com/2022/09/08/american-arcadia-preview-on-the-run-in-a-murderous-70s-utopia/]TheSixthAxis[/url]

For any [url=https://www.actugaming.net/apercu-american-arcadia-un-jeu-daventure-a-la-truman-show-qui-donne-envie-517003/]French[/url], [url=https://www.ingame.de/tests/american-arcadia-preview-gameplay-story-gamescom-2022-spieler-koeln-91752195.html]German[/url], or [url=https://ordenpixel.com/american-arcadia-primer-contacto/]Spanish [/url]fans, you can read similar impressions here! 

All in all it was a fantastic week, and so refreshing to sneak out of the Arcadia bubble and spend some time in the Gamescom bubble. We’re back at home working on the game now, but also planning our next escape! So stay tuned!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42313396/a3300c99a8b7158ae1381f130e8151fcaec475b9.jpg[/img]

If you’d like to get the latest info on American Arcadia you can follow us on Twitter at [url=https://twitter.com/AmericanArcadia]@AmericanArcadia[/url] and please consider [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1249040/American_Arcadia/]wishlisting us on Steam[/url] - it really helps indie developers!

Thanks, and stay groovy until next time -
Out of the Blue
